diagnostics.message: :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_iam_role.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_launch_template.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_eks_node_group.ng: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_iam_role.ng is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.aws_eks_fargate_profile.fargate: explicit depends_on of :resource.aws_iam_role.fargate is redundant — already implied by attribute references

The explicit dependency from :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng to :resource.aws_launch_template.ng duplicates the launch-template reference in the ASG configuration, which already establishes the ordering.

The explicit dependency from :resource.aws_autoscaling_group.ng to :resource.aws_iam_role.ng is already established transitively: the ASG depends on the launch template, which depends on the instance profile, which depends on the role.
The explicit dependency from :resource.aws_eks_node_group.ng to :resource.aws_iam_role.ng duplicates the direct reference to the role in node_role_arn.
The explicit dependency from :resource.aws_eks_fargate_profile.fargate to :resource.aws_iam_role.fargate duplicates the direct reference to the role in pod_execution_role_arn.

The explicit dependency from :resource.time_sleep.wait to :resource.aws_eks_cluster.cp is transitively established through the ASG and node-group dependencies, both of which depend on the EKS cluster.
